requirements.title: A Fortran main program is the program unit whose first statement is not another program-unit starter
requirements.definition: A Fortran main program is a program unit that does not contain a SUBROUTINE, FUNCTION, MODULE, SUBMODULE, or BLOCK DATA statement as its first statement.

pending.main-program-unit-classification: Compile a main program named main_unit with IMPLICIT NONE, initialize integer observed to -777, assign 42, and expect exact 42 at execution so the program unit is reached as the executable main program.
pending.main-program-first-statement-exclusion: Source-control plan compiles separate controls whose first statements are PROGRAM, SUBROUTINE, FUNCTION, MODULE, SUBMODULE, and BLOCK DATA; only the PROGRAM control executes as the main program, while the other starters are classified under their own program-unit rules.

requirements.title: program-stmt syntax admits PROGRAM followed by a program name
requirements.definition: A program-stmt has the form PROGRAM program-name.

pending.program-stmt-with-name: Compile a conforming control `program r1402_main; integer :: observed; observed=42; end program r1402_main` and expect exact 42 through execution.
pending.program-stmt-missing-name-rejected: Diagnostic/control pair deletes only the program-name after PROGRAM; the repaired source is the same main program with name r1402_main and matching END PROGRAM name.

requirements.title: end-program-stmt syntax admits END, END PROGRAM, and END PROGRAM name
requirements.definition: An end-program-stmt is END, END PROGRAM, or END PROGRAM followed by a program name.

pending.bare-end-program-stmt: Compile a control with PROGRAM r1403_bare and final bare END; initialize observed to -777 before assigning 42 and expect exact 42.
pending.end-program-keyword-stmt: Compile a control with PROGRAM r1403_keyword and final END PROGRAM; initialize observed to -777 before assigning 42 and expect exact 42.
pending.end-program-named-stmt: Compile a control with PROGRAM r1403_named and final END PROGRAM r1403_named; initialize observed to -777 before assigning 42 and expect exact 42.
pending.malformed-end-program-stmt-rejected: Diagnostic/control pair appends a second name token after END PROGRAM r1403_named; the repair removes only that extra token so R1403 is the reached syntax rule.

requirements.title: A main program may be supplied by non-Fortran means
requirements.definition: The main program is permitted to be defined by means other than Fortran.

requirements.title: A program with a non-Fortran main contains no Fortran main-program unit
requirements.definition: A program whose main program is defined by other than Fortran shall not contain a main-program program unit.

Source-control mutation adds a Fortran main-program unit to the same program; no diagnostic is required by this unnumbered restriction.

requirements.title: A Fortran main program cannot be referenced from any program unit
requirements.definition: No reference to a Fortran main-program shall appear in any program unit in the program, including itself.
